name: AQLEN Receipt Graph Query Commands

commands.label: Graph summary
commands.answers: How many nodes and edges are in this ledger graph?

commands.label: Score trace
commands.answers: Which evidence anchors, qubit receipts, noise events, and calibration receipts support this readiness score?

commands.label: Upstream evidence path
commands.answers: What upstream records contributed to this node?

commands.label: Downstream impact path
commands.answers: What later records depend on this evidence anchor?

commands.label: Immediate neighbors
commands.answers: What directly links into or out of this node?

claim_boundary: These query commands inspect prototype research receipts. They do not prove fault-tolerant quantum deployment or practical quantum computing readiness.
